# Data

**All data in this project are SYNTHETIC.** They are generated by `src/marketing_budget/synthetic/` from
the parameters in `configs/ground_truth_SYNTHETIC.yaml`, with a fixed seed.

**Why synthetic data were needed (D-001):** the project has to show that it can tell what advertising
*caused* apart from what ad platforms *claim*. That requires knowing the true effect of each channel, and no
public dataset provides it together with spend, a lead funnel, customer economics and experiments for
several businesses.

| Location | Contents | In git |
|---|---|---|
| `data/raw/` | Generated Parquet tables, all named `synthetic_*` (from phase 1) | No (rebuilt by the pipeline) |
| `data/processed/` | `marketing_SYNTHETIC.duckdb`, the SQL metric layer | No |
| `dashboard/data/` | `synthetic_*.csv` Tableau extracts (phase 6) | Yes, so the workbook can be built from GitHub |

The design of the simulation, the features it must contain and the data problems it injects are described in
`docs/data_design.md`.
